options: Calm down! Take hold of me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The elevator has a braking mechanism. The spikes in the shaft help break the fall too. We're not free falling yet.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Listen to yourself. Why are you holding me so tight then? Who is more panicky here?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The enemy below poses no threat for the moment, but watch out for attacks from above.
The last word has hardly come out. Several Corruptors jump down from above, landing on the already rickety elevator with a thump.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This isn't the kind of murderous aura Corruptors are supposed to have. Is someone controlling them?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha... The elevator is falling into pieces, and they are jumping on board to die with us...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hold tight, ${PlayerName}. Look at the height... We're counting on you to come up with something to save us from being smashed to a pulp.
